name: Tiffin Indian cuisine
hoursNote: Mon–Fri 11:30am–10pm · Sat–Sun noon–10pm (Apple Maps / listings); confirm on Instagram
description: South Philly outpost of Munish Narula's mini-chain: North Indian curries, tandoor, naan, and chaats. BYO wine with corkage.

name: Saigon Grace Cafe
hoursNote: Tue closed · Mon/Wed–Fri 8:30am–7pm · Sat–Sun 8:30am–4pm
description: Vietnamese coffee (salt foam) and Viet-Mexican cafe food from Khai Tran, Trinh Nguyen, and Fernando Cristobol. Listed in drinks as Saigon Cafe.

name: Pine Street Grill
hoursNote: Tue closed. Dinner hours above; Sat–Sun brunch 10:30am–2pm (not all-afternoon). Confirm on Instagram.
description: Fitler Square neighborhood grill from Amanda Shulman and Alex Kemp (Her Place, My Loup): comfort classics, kids menu, weekend brunch.

name: Ambrosia
hoursNote: Lunch and dinner seatings (afternoon gap). Last seating earlier than close. Wine welcome, no corkage.
description: Casual Italian at 24th & Locust: homemade pasta, full bar; still no corkage if you bring wine.

name: Lorenzo and Sons Pizza
hoursNote: Sun–Wed 11am–1am · Thu–Sat 11am–3am (Apple Maps). Cash-friendly giant slices.
description: South Street institution: huge New York-style slices, late night. Cash only (ATM on site).

name: Café y Chocolate
hoursNote: Sun–Thu 8am–5pm · Fri–Sat 8:30am–8pm on cafeychocolatephilly.com; summer brunch hours also posted — confirm on Instagram.
description: Mexican cafe at Snyder & Passyunk: breakfast, moles, and Mexican hot chocolate.

name: Tesiny
hoursNote: Tue–Sat 5–10pm · Sun–Mon closed
description: South Philly seafood / cocktail room. Dinner only.

name: Agrícola
hoursNote: Thu–Sat 4–9pm · Sun 2–7pm · Mon–Wed closed (listings). Confirm on Instagram — hours are limited.
description: Chef-y pizza at 10th & Federal: house-milled grain, farm pork, pizza classes. Look for the monkey over the door.

name: Casablanca Mediterranean Grill
hoursNote: Site: Tue–Thu 2–10pm (kitchen earlier); Fri–Sat prix fixe or a la carte. Open six days — confirm Monday on Instagram. Sun closed.
description: Family Mediterranean grill with a full bar (no longer BYOB). Best of Philly Mediterranean.

name: Paffuto
hoursNote: Mon–Tue closed. Daytime cafe + some dinner services; site and Cash App disagree on exact dinner nights — confirm on Instagram.
description: Italian cafe/restaurant in the old Bibou space (CIA alums). Breakfast sandwiches by day, dinner some evenings.

name: Juana Tamale
hoursNote: Closed Mondays. ~11am–10pm other days (listings); birria often sells out — confirm on Instagram.
description: Neon Mexican BYOB from Chef Jennifer Zavala: birria tacos and ramen, handmade tamales, vegan options.

name: Pho 75
hoursNote: Every day 9am–8pm. Cash-friendly pho shop in Wing Phat Plaza.
description: South Philly's iconic pho: eye-round, brisket, tendon, tripe, meatballs. Look for the yellow banner.

name: El Chingon
hoursNote: Mon closed · Tue–Thu & Sun 11am–9pm · Fri–Sat 11am–10pm
description: Mexican restaurant on 10th Street — lunch through dinner.

name: Mawn
hoursNote: Dinner Wed–Sat 4:30–9pm (reservations). Walk-in lunch Thu–Sat 11am–2:30pm. Afternoon gap. Confirm on Instagram.
description: James Beard Cambodian noodle house on 9th Street. Tiny BYOB; dinner books out — lunch is the walk-in play.

name: Fiorella
hoursNote: Sun–Thu 4–9pm · Fri–Sat 4–10pm
description: Marc Vetri pasta restaurant on Christian Street. Dinner only.

name: The Dutch
hoursNote: Brunch Mon–Fri 8am–3pm · Sat–Sun 8am–2pm (walk-in)
description: Pennsylvania Dutch-inspired scratch kitchen and bar; sister to Fond. Brunch / lunch hours.

name: Cilantro
hoursNote: Mon–Thu & Sat–Sun noon–11pm · Fri noon–midnight (dine-in). Carryout ends 30 min earlier.
description: Halal Egyptian / Mediterranean on 4th Street: shawarma, hawawshi, falafel platters.

name: Ameri Thai Bistro
hoursNote: Mon closed · Tue–Thu 4–9pm · Fri–Sat 11am–10pm · Sun 11am–9pm
description: Neighborhood Thai on Snyder: curries, boat noodles, mango sticky rice. Lunch Fri–Sun; dinner Tue–Sun.

name: The Bakery
hoursNote: Handle is @thebakery.phl (not .ph). Mon–Fri 7am–2pm · Sat–Sun 8am–2pm. Friday pizza nights / After Hours dinners — confirm on Instagram.
description: 3rd & Wolf donuts, coffee, and breakfast sandwiches. Rocco Weiss revived a century-old cake-donut recipe; pizza nights via IG.

name: Horseman Wellness Club
hoursNote: Mon–Tue closed · Wed–Sat 8am–4pm · Sun 8am–3pm (listings). Confirm on Instagram.
description: Whole-food cafe / meal-prep shop: grass-fed cooking, breakfast and lunch. Closed early week.

name: Café Tinto (Olney)
hoursNote: Mon–Sat 5:30am–2pm · Sunday closed (family day). Confirm on Instagram.

name: Café Tinto (Fishtown)
hoursNote: Mon–Sat ~6am–3pm · Sunday typically closed. Location also posts as @cafetinto.fishtown; occasional 3–6pm happy hour — confirm on IG.

name: Angelo's Pizzeria
hoursNote: Wed–Sun 11am–7pm · Mon–Tue closed. Lines are the point — confirm on Instagram.

hoursNote: Weekend mornings from 6am; weekdays 9 or 10am–9pm (listings). Chef Cristina Martinez also @barbacoachef. Confirm on Instagram — they can sell out.

hoursNote: Yelp: Mon/Wed–Sat 9am–11pm · Tue 9am–9pm · Sun 10am–7pm. Confirm on Instagram.
